name: kapso
description: Run Kapso, the engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution and learns from every run, from this session: set up, state the objective with its evaluation, launch and follow the experiments, review and deploy the winner, learn from the run, author a harness for your domain.

interface.shortDescription: Run experiments toward an objective, deploy the winner, learn from the run
interface.longDescription: Kapso is an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution and learns from every run: it proposes candidate solutions from previous experiments and its bank of lessons, implements each on its own branch, measures it against your evaluation, keeps the best, deploys it on your stack and learns from the run. The plugin sets Kapso up, writes the objective and its evaluation with you, launches and follows the campaign, reviews and deploys the result, learns from it, and authors a harness for your domain.
defaultPrompt: Set up Kapso on this machine and check it is ready
Build a better churn model here and prove it beats the current one
Write a Kapso harness for this repository's domain
